explanation: This is safe. The enhanced for loop iterates `new ArrayList<>(nums)`, a snapshot copy, while the removal mutates the original `nums` — the iterator belongs to the copy, so no ConcurrentModificationException can be thrown. A tempting wrong answer reads this as the classic remove-while-iterate bug, which only crashes when the loop and the mutation share the same list.
prompt: The loop removes even numbers from nums while iterating. Does it throw ConcurrentModificationException?
left_label: Safe — iterates a copy, no CME
